svg.title: Classifying Periodic Variable Stars. Gaia DR3 light curves, classified with machine-learning sequence models.
svg.desc: A Gaia DR3 photometry project that classifies RR Lyrae, Cepheids, long-period variables, and eclipsing binaries. The notebook uses Pandas and NumPy for data preparation, scikit-learn for preprocessing and evaluation, and TensorFlow/Keras sequence models, with plots from Matplotlib and Seaborn. Original RR Lyrae photometry plot from the project notebook.
